attchmntText: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Assignment of long-term credit rating of AA-/Stable to ECap Equities Ltd, a whollyowned subsidiary of the Company'.
voiceSummary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited informs that Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited assigned a rating of IVR AA- Stable to the proposed Non-convertible Debentures programme of Rs. 100 crores for ECap Equities Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary. The rating letter is dated November 12, 2026. This rating is based on a consolidated view of Edelweiss Financial Services Limited and its subsidiaries, considering close operational, financial, and managerial linkages.

attchmntText: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Business Update (in US Dollars) of Zuno General Insurance Limited, a subsidiary of the Company.'
voiceSummary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited filed a business update for its subsidiary Zuno General Insurance Limited for November 2026. The update reports Zuno achieved a 49% Gross Written Premium growth in H1FY27, reaching 81 million US Dollars. The company turned profitable in H1FY27 with a Profit Before Tax of 0.1 million US Dollars. Zuno recorded a Combined Operating Ratio of 118% and an Operating Expense ratio of 11.1%. The subsidiary highlighted a 44% four-year Compound Annual Growth Rate in Private Car Gross Written Premium. It also noted 10 million customers and a 4.6-star app rating. The document includes forward-looking statements and standard disclaimers regarding market risks and management estimates.

attchmntText: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Business Update (in INR) of Zuno General Insurance Limited, a subsidiary of the Company.'
voiceSummary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited filed a business update for its subsidiary Zuno General Insurance Limited for November 2026. Zuno General Insurance reported a 49% year-over-year growth in Gross Written Premium, reaching Rs. 781 Crore in H1FY27. The company achieved a Profit Before Tax of Rs. 1 Crore in H1FY27, marking its first profitability. Combined Operating Ratio improved to 118% from 128% in H1FY26. Operating expenses ratio declined to 11.1% from 15.8% in the same period. Assets Under Management grew 26% to Rs. 1,895 Crore. The update highlighted a 44% four-year CAGR in Private Car Gross Written Premium. Zuno emphasized its digital platform, AI integration, and usage-based insurance products. The document contains forward-looking statements and management estimates.

attchmntText: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Earnings Update (in USD)'.
voiceSummary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited filed an earnings update for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated profit after tax was US $20 million, a 50 percent year-on-year increase. Net worth stood at US $585 million, while net debt decreased by 26 percent to US $879 million. Alternative Asset Management profit after tax rose 27 percent to US $9 million. Mutual Fund profit after tax increased 114 percent to US $4 million. Zuno General Insurance turned profitable with a profit after tax of US $1 million. Edelweiss Alternatives listed on November 2, 2026. Carlyle became a strategic majority investor in Nido.

attchmntText: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Earnings Update (in INR)'.
voiceSummary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited filed an earnings update for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated profit after tax for the quarter was 193 Cr, a 50% year-on-year increase. Net worth stood at 5,615 Cr as of September 2026. Corporate net debt decreased by 18% year-on-year to 8,435 Cr. Alternative Asset Management profit after tax rose 27% to 88 Cr. Mutual Fund profit after tax increased 114% to 37 Cr. Zuno General Insurance turned profitable with a profit after tax of 5 Cr. Asset Reconstruction Company profit after tax was 78 Cr. ECL Finance profit after tax was 4 Cr. Edelweiss Life Insurance Company reported a loss of 22 Cr. Edelweiss Alternatives was listed on November 2, 2026. Carlyle became a strategic majority investor in Nido.

attchmntText: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved the results on November 13, 2026. Consolidated post-minority interest profit after tax for the quarter was INR 193 Cr, up 50% year-on-year. Revenue for the quarter was INR 2,602 Cr, up 37% year-on-year. For the six-month period, consolidated post-minority interest profit after tax was INR 315 Cr, up 61% year-on-year. Revenue for the six months was INR 5,021 Cr, up 20% year-on-year. Auditors M/s Nangia & Co. LLP issued an unmodified opinion. The company also enclosed a security cover certificate and a statement on the utilization of non-convertible debenture proceeds.

attchmntText: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP

Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Receipt of request from Mr. Venkatachalam Ramaswamy and Ms. Aparna T. C., seeking reclassification from the "Promoter / Promoter Group" category to the "Public" category '.
voiceSummary: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has received the resignation of Mr. Venkatachalam Ramaswamy, DIN 00008509, from the Board of Directors and as Vice Chairman, effective November 11, 2026. The resignation was received via email on November 11, 2026, at 7:48 p.m., despite the letter being dated November 9, 2026. Additionally, the Company received a formal request from Mr. Ramaswamy and Ms. Aparna T. C. to reclassify their status from Promoter to Public category. This request is subject to consideration by the Board, receipt of a No-Objection Letter from Stock Exchanges, and approval by Members under Regulation 31A of SEBI LODR.
